name: routing_v6
instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which specific issue is the customer asking about?

criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account; accounts for children/teenagers
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Using Apple Pay or Google Pay; adding the card to a phone wallet
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs can be used, where to withdraw cash, ATM availability
criteria.automatic_top_up: Setting up or how auto top-up works
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Balance not updated after a bank transfer into the account; incoming transfer not showing
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Deposited a cheque or cash but balance not updated
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a payee/beneficiary; beneficiary not allowed
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel or reverse a transfer they made, e.g. sent to wrong account
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card expiring soon; getting a replacement for an expiring card
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted; will merchants take my card
criteria.card_arrival: Ordered card has not arrived yet; tracking card delivery
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes; delivery time for a new card
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the app/account; re-adding a found card
criteria.card_not_working: Card not working, generally broken or stopped working
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: Charged a fee for a card payment or purchase, including an extra fee for buying something from another country/abroad
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A payment or charge on the account that the customer did not make or does not recognise; an unknown charge; unexplained money appearing in the account
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Wrong exchange rate applied to a card payment abroad
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: Charged a fee for an ATM cash withdrawal
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: ATM withdrawal on account the customer did not make
criteria.change_pin: Wants to change or update an existing card PIN
criteria.compromised_card: Card details may be compromised or used by someone else; card security concern
criteria.country_support: Which countries the bank/service is available in; whether someone living in a given country can sign up or get a card
criteria.declined_card_payment: Card payment was declined or rejected at a merchant
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: Unrecognised direct debit on the account
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits on disposable virtual cards, how many uses
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing name, address or other personal details
criteria.exchange_charge: Questions about what fees apply to currency exchange, how much exchanging costs
criteria.exchange_charge_disputed: Complains that the fee already charged for a currency exchange is wrong or too high
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rate is used; how exchange rates are determined
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies in the app
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexpected small extra charge of a specific amount (e.g. an extra £1 or $1 charge, even if pending) on the statement that the customer asks to have explained
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed; why did my transfer not go through
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which fiat currencies are supported for holding/exchanging
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get a disposable virtual card
criteria.get_physical_card: Getting a physical card; does not have a PIN yet or where to find the PIN for a new card
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get a virtual card
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone with the app lost or stolen
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot app passcode/password; locked out of app
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked after wrong attempts; unblock PIN
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money/salary into the account
criteria.refund_not_showing_up: A merchant refund has not appeared on the account
criteria.request_refund: Wants a refund for a purchase or to cancel a purchase/order; how to get a refund
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment was reverted/returned to the account
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which of the customer's own cards and currencies can be used to top up or pay in
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fee for topping up by bank transfer
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fee for topping up by card
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up with cash or cheque
criteria.top_up_limits: Maximum amounts and limits: top-up limits, daily limits on the card or account
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up using a card
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: Charged a fee for a transfer
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer/deposit money into my account
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Recipient has not received the transfer
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up / top-up verification code
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Which card brands the bank issues (Visa or Mastercard); what cards do you offer or carry
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave the wrong amount of cash
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Wrong exchange rate on a cash withdrawal abroad
